title.narrative: Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit Development Project Readiness Financing (Line 5, Southern Route)

description.narrative:
The proposed PRF will support the preparation and high project readiness of the ensuing loan. The PRF will prepare the detailed feasibility study, engineering design, and procurement document; and provide assistance in procurement-related processes.
The ensuing project of MRT Line 5 (Southern Route) will comprise a total length of about 17.4 km between Gabtoli and Dasherkandi stations. The congested central area of Dhaka requires 12.8 km of underground section with 12 stations, while the remaining section will be elevated with 4 stations. The ensuing project will be considered after completing the engineering design supported by the PRF.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Feasibility study, engineering design and procurement support completed. Progress/Status: The Notice to Start Services was issued to the Design Consultant on 7 April 2021. The Service will be carried out in the following sequence: (i) a detailed feasibility study (April 2021 to December 2021); (ii) a detailed engineering design (January 2022 to March 2023); and (iii) tender assistance (April 2023 to March 2024).
Overall, despite the impact of the COVID-19 related restrictions, the project has progressed mostly on track. The design consultants submitted the feasibility study report to DMTCL on 6 January 2022 and to ADB on 25 January 2022. It covers all the areas of the project's design and includes draft safeguards documents.
Three individual consulting services packages have been awarded, (i) internal audit firm, (ii) railways specialist, and (iii) structure specialist in 2021. One individual consulting package for procurement specialist was signed on 17 January 2024.
